content.rendered: Our school carnival is a fun night for everyone!  The evening will be filled with games, inflatables, face painting, and some fun Food Trucks to chose from.  We will have lots of cool gift baskets to bid on as well as a chance to win a Great Wolf Lodge package valued at $800.   Come and have some fun!
